cohort.source: corrected C1 V2 primary regular cohort

theorem_contract.axis_regularity: For one coordinate axis e_i, certify a strict whole-cell sign for D_i f.
theorem_contract.opposite_face_signs: After orienting the axis so D_i f > 0, certify f<0 on the entry coordinate face and f>0 on the opposite exit coordinate face.
theorem_contract.graph_patch: For every transverse coordinate in the rectangular opposite-face domain, continuity plus strict monotonicity gives exactly one zero along the axis chord. The zero set inside the cell is therefore a local graph over that connected transverse rectangle.
theorem_contract.claim_boundary: This is a local cell graph-patch property only; it is not a global component or global topology statement.

axis_search.selection_if_multiple_axes_certify: maximize min(derivative_margin, entry_face_margin, exit_face_margin), tie-break X then Y then Z

outputs: axis regularity state and margin for X/Y/Z
entry/exit face sign states and margins for every regular axis
forbidden_inferences: coverage of zero set outside the certified cell
